CRM Core Jira items by area

Every CRM Core initiative, epic and story in the Jira filter, any year and any status. Each area has a short summary and a hierarchy you can fold at the initiative, epic or story. Open a hierarchy, then use “Show down to” to stop at the level you want. Jira was read only. Run date 2026-10-26.

How items were placed: each item gets exactly one area, matched on its title. 1010 items matched an area phrase directly. 201 items had no area phrase and took their parent's area. 1735 items matched nothing and sit under “Not in the six areas”. Greyed rows are parents kept for context, or items counted in another area. Status mix (top): 1475 Done, 1073 To Do, 116 Story Grooming, 55 Story Ready, 48 Story Elaboration, 47 In Progress, 45 PM Acceptance Queue, 33 ON Hold.
Timeline, as of 2026-10-26. Done items are closed and are not treated as slipped. For everything else, planned means a Fix Version on or after today, slipped means every Fix Version is already past, and unplanned means Backlog. Open-story pace uses stories Jira shows as resolved Done (last 6 months (2026-04-26 to 2026-10-26): 70 stories done, 11.7 per month; prior 6 months (2025-10-26 to 2026-04-26): 60 stories done, 10 per month). At that pace the 1208 open stories would take 103.2–120.8 team-months. Per-area figures are that same team working only on the area, so they add up to the total. The latest planned Fix Version still on an open item is 27.01 (~3.2 mo). Fix Versions are a plan, not a ship date.
